Definition: from G3110; Macedonia, a region of Greece:--Macedonia.
BiblicalUsage: Macedonia was the province north of Greece where the gospel first took root in Europe. Acts 16:9 has the man of Macedonia pleading, come over and help us, and 2 Corinthians 8:1 tells of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia, while Philippians 4:15 says no church shared with Paul in giving and receiving when he departed from Macedonia but the Philippians only.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Macedonia is the pattern of a giving church: poor, generous, and first in line to share. My position is that 2 Corinthians 8:1 and Philippians 4:15 belong together, because the grace that was bestowed on those churches came straight back out as giving.
